'''Melina Furman''' (18 July 1975 – 6 September 2024) was an Argentine investigative author, teacher and biologist.<ref name="infobae">{{cite news |title=Murió Melina Furman, la referente educativa que activaba los superpoderes del cerebro con "experimentos" |url=https://www.infobae.com/sociedad/2024/09/07/murio-melina-furman-la-referente-educativa-que-activaba-los-superpoderes-del-cerebro-con-experimentos/ |access-date=7 September 2024 |publisher=infobae |date=7 September 2024}}</ref><ref name="profile">{{cite web |title=Melina Furman |url=https://udesa.edu.ar/cuerpo-docente/melina-furman |website=Universidad de San Andrés |date=9 July 2015 |access-date=7 September 2024}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
Furman was born on 18 July 1975. She graduated from the [[Universidad de Buenos Aires]] with a certificate in biologic sciences, and with a masters and a Ph.D. from [[Columbia University]] in the United States.<ref name="profile"/> Furman worked as investigative professor at the [[Universidad de San Andres]].

She is considered by many, such as Argentine columnist [[Sebastian Campanero]], as "the most influential education thinker in Spanish".<ref name="nacion">{{cite news |title=Adiós a Melina Furman, la pensadora de la educación más influyente en habla hispana |url=https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/adios-a-melina-furman-la-pensadora-de-la-educacion-mas-influyente-en-habla-hispana-nid07092024/ |access-date=7 September 2024 |publisher=La Nacion |date=7 September 2024}}</ref>

Furman died of colon cancer on 6 September 2024, at the age of 49.<ref name="infobae"/><ref name="nacion"/>
